notes.subject: סעפים
notes.rationale: 'ol i wokim dua-dua long tingting' o 'ol man i no stret long tingting' — YLT 'doubting ones', KJV 'vain thoughts'.

notes.subject: les long
notes.rationale: D3: שנא = les long / birua; mi les long em i narapela mining bilong birua.

notes.subject: bilong yu
notes.rationale: Tok i go long Yahwe, olsem Tora bilong yu.

translation: Ol man i gat tingting dua-dua mi les long ol, tasol Tora bilong yu mi laikim tru.

tokens.gloss: ol man i gat tingting dua-dua
